notes: Final WAV files are trimmed, mono 44.1 kHz game-ready edits made from recorded-source files.
Fire samples preserve the real Mosin report tail while avoiding the long raw sequence.
Bolt/reload cues are split so the viewmodel animation can trigger open, eject, insert, close, and finish sounds separately.
